svg.title: How StockSaathi is put together
svg.desc: In the browser: Installable web app (Vanilla ES modules, a hash router and a custom SVG charting engine. No framework and no build step.) Then: Front door: Cloudflare Worker (Routes every request and fails over to a hot mirror on errors or timeouts.) Then: API: Python functions on Vercel (Orders, portfolio, coach and report card.); Edge functions (The paths where latency matters.) Then: Data: Postgres (Row-level security throughout. Cross-user reads go through RPCs.); Quote layer (Cache first, then a chain of market-data providers.)
